Assignment Question:
A library wants to develop a Java application to manage its collection of books using a HashMap. Each book ID is used as the key, and the corresponding book price is stored as the value. The system should allow the librarian to add book details, display all books, and search for the price of a particular book using its book ID. 
 
Input and Output Format
Input Format
·       The first line contains an integer n, representing the number of books.
·       The next n lines contain two values:
o   Book ID
o   Book price
·       The last line contains the book ID to be searched.
Output Format
·       Display each book ID and its corresponding price.
·       Display the price of the searched book if the book ID exists.
·       If the book ID does not exist, display Book ID not found.
